one_liner: A lightweight particle‑based fog effect that uses a configurable texture and simple particle system to create ambient mist in a Hyperfy world.
primary_use_case: Add atmospheric fog or mist to a scene for visual ambience without heavy performance cost.
preview_recommendation: The attached MP4 preview clearly demonstrates the fog particles in motion; it is suitable for inclusion in the app gallery.
manifest_quality_notes: Preview video available and matches app behavior
Model size <10 KB, script <2 KB – lightweight
No networking or update loops used
All required assets bundled in .hyp file
